values.note: Reservable on MyCountyParks at least 3 days ahead; sites not reserved are first come, first served, paid at the self-pay kiosk (cash or check). Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon. Cancellations: 30+ days a coupon for the full amount less the $4 MyCountyParks fee; 15-29 days less $10 a night; under 15 days no refund.

note: Muscatine County Conservation campground on the west side of Deep Lakes Park, a 435-acre former sand and gravel quarry just south of Muscatine with about 120 acres of clear lakes among sand dunes. Opened April 2026, with an on-site host. A paved trail runs from the campground to the cabins (about 0.5 mi) and the main access with beach, docks and boat ramp on Lake Chester (about 1 mi). --Claude
summary: Open and taking nightly bookings (opened April 15, 2026; reservable 3+ days ahead, else first-come at the kiosk). Confirmed 21 full-hookup 20/30/50-amp sites, showers; added pull-throughs, 14-night limit, season mid-April to Oct 31. $40 fee is AWH's manual read, untouched. Stays not waterfront.
flags: OPEN, BOOKING NIGHTLY: yes. The county says the campground 'opened on April 15, 2026', and each of the 21 site pages takes online reservations ('$0 - 40 /Night'); currently closed for the season (November-March).

FEES (manual, untouched): the $40 read by AWH matches the site pages' '$0 - 40 /Night'. The booking adds a $4 MyCountyParks fee per reservation (named in the refund policy); fees.reservation_fee 4 could be added by hand.
FIT OK: concrete pads 13 ft x 80-84 ft, ten pull-throughs.

WATERFRONT (confirms not waterfront; lead on Bebe's Pond): the county's campground map shows 'Bebe's Pond' at the campground's northeast corner beside sites 1-3. On NAIP that pond is roughly 110 x 115 m and irregular, about 1 ha (~2.5-3 acres), under the 5-acre line and called a pond by the county, so at most `pond` for sites 1-3 if the ground behind them is open to the edge; imagery predates the campground and the trees on the pond's west shore stand between, and none of the 21 site photos shows water. Unsure after every source, so it stays not waterfront. The park's real lakes are farther: the big lake to the southeast about 160 m through woods, the lake north of the campground across 41st St (a county road) behind a treeline. Overpass was down this session (distances are imagery estimates).

PIN OK: 41.37742,-91.08221 is at the campground entrance off 41st St, at the north edge of the sand clearing where the campground map puts the sites (imagery predates the build, so the pads themselves are not visible).
